recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce R5 element-level trial-use markers in current core unless FMG/FHIR-I makes a new R6+ decision for STU elements inside normative resources; use FHIR-54783 or successor work for that broader mechanism.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I technical correction raised against R4 and applied for R5, asking that all elements newly added to already normative FHIR-core artifacts since R4 be marked Trial Use.
initial_application: Jira records Git master cc475f0dcf. That commit added structuredefinition-standards-status=trial-use markers to new elements in CapabilityStatement, CodeSystem, ElementDefinition, Observation, OperationDefinition, StructureDefinition, and ValueSet.
additional_context: The affected resources are active current-build sources and now identify version 6.0.0 with root standards-status=normative. Later R6 normative-ballot cleanup commits removed element-level trial-use flags from normative resources and removed mixed trial-use notes. FMG 2025-05-11 minutes said trial-use elements in normative resources in R6 need a policy and should not be trial-use content unless FMG approves; FHIR-54783 deferred the broader future mechanism outside R6 core.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding the R5 trial-use markers would undo later R6 normative-ballot source history and conflict with the current normative-resource policy context.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-I minutes record that this discussion led to creating FHIR-40493 to mark all new elements as TU.
